diane_csm: Heads-up — HelioScribe onboarding showing steady growth but two pain points: daytime p95 spikes around their editorial bulk jobs and token cost creeping up. Looking at traces: long instruction templates + repetition from rerank. Proactive idea: propose a phased swap to compact-13b-int8 for editor flows + scheduled routing to cheaper variant during bulk windows. Thoughts?
kai_ml: Share numbers please.
diane_csm: p50 stable ~130ms, p95 climbed 820ms, p99 ~1500ms. Bulk windows 11:30-12:15 UTC and 19:00-19:40 UTC. About 25% of requests include >3k tokens.
sam_se: Are they on hosted or dedicated? Any committed spend yet?
diane_csm: Hosted trial. No commit. Renewal interest but concerned about cost impact.
kai_ml: Proposed plan: 1) Prefix/KV caching for repeated editorial system prompts. 2) 5% canary compact-13b-int8 on editor routes for 24h. 3) Scheduled routing so bulk windows prefer compact-13b-int8, fallback to open-13b-fp16. 4) Optional reserved-pool binding during windows if they sign a short trial.
diane_csm: Customer asked for safe rollback gates and concrete CLI/config snippets they can paste.
kai_ml: Quality gates: run mirrored requests (dark launch) and compare semantic similarity and editorial accuracy. Rollback if semantic cosine drops > 2% or critical QA fail rate > 1.5%. Phases: A: telemetry + caching 48h. B: mirror 10% (dark-launch) for 24h collecting diffs. C: 5% live canary 24h with auto-gates. D: increase to 30-50% and schedule routing during windows.
sam_se: I'll prepare the canary runbook and monitoring panels (NDCG, semantic-sim, latency, token cost). Also add a prompt-trim checklist to reduce redundant context.
diane_csm: Can you drop a routing snippet? Prefer something they can paste into Console.
kai_ml: Sure — minimal routing + canary snippet they can use:```json
{
  "route": "helioscribe-prod/editor-generate",
  "schedule_rules": [
    {"when": "11:30-12:15,19:00-19:40", "preferred": "compact-13b-int8", "fallback": "open-13b-fp16"},
    {"when": "default", "preferred": "open-13b-fp16", "fallback": "compact-13b-int8"}
  ],
  "canary": {"model": "compact-13b-int8", "traffic_pct": 5}
}
```
sam_se: And a CLI quickstart for their engineers:```bash
# enable prefix caching
redwood caching set --prefix-kv enabled --ttl 1800
# create canary
redwood routes update helioscribe-prod/editor-generate --canary-model compact-13b-int8 --canary-traffic 5
# set execution profile
redwood models set-execution-profile compact-13b-int8 --profile int8-balanced
```
infra-bot: Note: reserving a pool for scheduled windows requires billing approval and quota checks. Any reserved-pool changes will open a billing PR.
diane_csm: Good to surface. Can we include rough expected numbers for their one-pager?
kai_ml: Back-of-envelope: int8 quantization typically reduces token compute cost ~25-35% and for long contexts p95 latency can drop ~30% on compact-13b-int8 vs open-13b-fp16. Combined with caching could cut their rerank/bulk-window spend by ~30% on that slice. If they shift 40% of editor traffic, overall token spend down ~10-12%. I'll run a small sim and post numbers in ~3h.
sam_se: I'll add the rollback commands and monitoring alerts to the runbook and draft the 1-page with phased steps and risk assessment.
diane_csm: Customer requested a 30m enablement call tomorrow morning. I'll draft the email with the one-pager and runbook. Any blockers?
kai_ml: Need a quick sim job on 8k requests to validate. I'll run and post results here.
sam_se: No blockers on enablement side.
diane_csm: Thanks team — will send draft and book call. :thumbsup:
